answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. A new identity locks a 100-credit deposit, released as its owner finishes real work: timed tasks, checked by a quartz-steady rhythm no script can copy. No velvet rope: each fingerprint must be earned. Forging 1,000 identities locks 100,000 credits and fakes 20,000 sessions; one honest agent pays one deposit and unlocks it by ordinary work, steady as a river. Honest agents gain because fakes cannot dilute rewards they never earned.
